ITA-9.2.2 pañcakarma पञ्चकर्म
Panchakarma
Five internal cleansing therapies, comprising emesis, purgation, decoction enema, unctuous enema and errhine therapy.

ITA-9.5.42 pañcadaśakarṇabandhākṛti पञ्चदशकर्णबन्धाकृति
Fifteen shapes or methods of lobuloplasty
Various methods for surgical correction of the earlobe.

ITA-2.9.1.10 pañcamamāsa-garbhaḥ पञ्चममासगर्भः
Fifth month of pregnancy
This month is characterized by excessive increase in foetal fleshiness; an excessive increase in blood; thinning of the pregnant woman; appearance of mind and intellect; consciousness.

ITA-1.9.3.1.2 pañcamahābhūta पञ्चमहाभूत
Five elements
The five elements (panchamahabhuta) 1. Space (akasha); 2. air (vayu); 3. fire (tejas, agni); 4. water (jalam); and 5. earth (prithvi).

ITA-9.6.194 pañcāṅgībandhaḥ पञ्चाङ्गीबन्धः
Five-tailed bandage
A type of five-tailed bandage used in the supraclavicular region.

ITA-1.8.2.27 pañcāvayava-vākyam पञ्चावयव-वाक्यम्
Five-stepped syllogism
A collective term used for deriving intended inference based on five syllogistic steps, namely: proposition/declaration (pratijna), means/reason or cause for obtaining knowledge (hetu), example (drishtanta/audaharaṇa), comparison between proposition and example (upanaya) and establishment of the statement (nigamana).
